site_local_title: Built for how business is done here
site_local_calendar_text: Dates are entered and shown on the Ethiopian calendar, and documents are numbered by the Ethiopian fiscal year. Switch to Gregorian when a supplier needs it.
site_local_language_text: Every screen in both. Each person chooses their own language.
site_local_tax_text: VAT, TOT and withholding tax are worked out on each sale and purchase, with the TIN and receipt numbers your accountant asks for.
site_local_device_text: Nothing to install. It runs in the browser on the phone in your pocket and the computer in the office.
site_day_title: A day at the store, with it
site_day_morning_text: A delivery arrives. The storekeeper receives it against the purchase order; lots, expiry dates and costs go in with it.
site_day_selling_text: The cashier sells at the till. Stock comes off the right lot, the receipt prints, and credit sales land on the customer's account.
site_day_closing_text: The shift is closed and the drawer counted. A shortage is on the record, with the name of who was on the till.
site_day_month: At the end of the month
site_day_month_text: You read what sold, what is owed to you and what needs ordering, from your phone.

site_faq_trial_q: What happens when the trial ends?
site_faq_trial_a: Your data stays where it is. The business is paused until the first payment, and as soon as it is confirmed everyone can work again.
site_faq_late_q: What if a payment is late?
site_faq_late_a: You have {grace} more days to pay while everything keeps working. After that the business is paused, not deleted.
site_faq_change_a: Yes. Choose a different package the next time you pay; it applies from that payment.
site_faq_limit_q: What if I reach my user limit?
site_faq_limit_a: You are told when you add the next user. Move to a larger package, or switch off an account you no longer need.
site_faq_data_a: Yes. Every list exports to Excel (CSV) and PDF, whenever you like.
site_faq_setup_q: Will you help me set up?
site_faq_setup_a: Yes. Send us your item list and we help you import it. Write or call from the contact page.
site_pricing_close: Try it with your own stock before you pay anything.

site_about_title: Software made in Addis Ababa, for the way business works here.
site_about_intro: Digital Construct designs, builds and runs websites and business systems for Ethiopian companies. Stock is the one we built for everyone who buys, stores and sells goods.
site_about_why_1: A shop's numbers usually live in three places: the bin card in the store, the receipt book at the counter and the owner's memory. They rarely agree, and finding out why takes an evening nobody has.
site_about_why_2: Stock keeps them as one record. A delivery, a sale, a transfer or a count is entered once, by the person doing it, and the balance, the cost and the money owed all follow from it.
site_about_why_3: We kept the paperwork people already know. There is still a GRN, a bin card, a proforma and a withholding receipt. They are just never out of date.
site_about_principles_title: What we hold the product to
site_about_p1_text: Amharic and English on every screen, Ethiopian dates, birr, and the words a storekeeper in Addis Ababa actually uses.
site_about_p2_title: It fits the paperwork you know
site_about_p2_text: Vouchers print the way they are filed, numbered by branch and fiscal year, with the TIN and tax lines in place.
site_about_p3_text: One business never sees another's records, and every list you keep can be exported whenever you want it.
site_about_p4_text: The people who built it are the people you reach by phone or email when something is unclear.
